title: Workshop place reservation
purpose: Describe a candidate feature that lets visitors reserve a place in a workshop, with undecided policies recorded as open questions.

scope.text: Let visitors reserve a place in a workshop.

requirements.text: Let visitors reserve a place in a workshop.

stories.text: As a visitor, I want to reserve a place in a workshop.
acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor and a workshop, when the visitor submits a reservation for that workshop, then the reservation is recorded for that visitor and workshop.
Given a submitted reservation, when the visitor checks the reservation, then the visitor is shown as holding a place in that workshop.

edge_cases.text: Proposed check: whether a workshop has remaining places, and what a visitor sees when it does not, is undecided.

dependencies.text: We have not decided whether reservations need payment, an account, a capacity limit or cancellation.
No owner or release date is assigned.

risks.text: Building the reservation flow before the payment, account, capacity-limit and cancellation decisions are made may require rework, because each undecided policy changes what a reservation must do.

success_metrics.text: Proposed verification: confirm that a visitor can submit a reservation for a workshop and that the reservation is recorded for that visitor and workshop.

open_questions: Is there a capacity limit on reservations?
Is cancellation of a reservation supported?
